## Description of Changes
Briefly describe what this pull request does, why it's needed, and what problem it solves.

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue number if applicable)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🎨 UI / Styling enhancement (Pop-Art comic theme tweaks)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization (Rust traversal, hashing, or rendering)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (guides, specs, or README)

## Checklist Before Submitting
- [ ] My code follows ByteMap's coding style and **Zero-Database Policy**.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm test` and all unit tests passed cleanly.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm build` and verified 0 TypeScript compilation errors.
- [ ] If I changed Rust code in `src-tauri/`, I ran `cargo fmt --all --check`.
- [ ] I tested this locally on my machine (Windows / macOS / Linux).

## Screenshots / Demo (if applicable)
If you changed UI components or visual styles, drop before/after screenshots here!
